comment: The fonts of the OpenZone window in VPP (the mockup of 2026-11-12 is set in Fira Sans and Fira Sans Condensed). build_fonts.py turns each entry into OpenZone_VPP/gui/fonts/<name>.fnt + .edds with the series' converter (openzone-research/source/fonts). kind bitmap = FNT3 (TextWidget, buttons; an edit box draws it at the atlas's own pixel size), kind sdf = FNT5 distance field (wrapped text: MultilineTextWidget, RichTextWidget). cell = the atlas resolution; a layout sets the size on screen with "exact text size" (whole numbers only). See README.md for the CSS-size table. Two keys are this repository's own (build_fonts.py applies them): track = atlas pixels added after every glyph (letter spacing), ink = the coverage curve that makes a small size as heavy as a browser draws it.

outputs.name: ozv_sansm28
outputs.for: names and values in medium weight, CSS 11 to 16 px

outputs.name: ozv_sansb28
outputs.for: button captions and bold names, CSS 11 to 16 px

outputs.name: ozv_cond28
outputs.for: legends, module names, small headings, CSS 11 to 16 px

outputs.name: ozv_cond44
outputs.for: page titles and big numbers, CSS 17 to 26 px

outputs.name: ozv_condm28
outputs.for: condensed medium labels, CSS 11 to 16 px

outputs.name: ozv_condb44
outputs.for: the OPENZONE wordmark, CSS 17 to 26 px

outputs.name: ozv_field16
outputs.for: edit boxes: CSS 14 px on a 1080-high screen (an edit box ignores exact text size)

outputs.name: ozv_sdf_sans32
outputs.for: wrapped notes: the engine draws a distance field heavier, so the Light face reads as Regular

outputs.name: ozv_sdf_sansm32
outputs.for: wrapped text in a heavier weight: the Regular face reads as Medium

outputs.name: ozv_condt28
outputs.for: legends in spaced capitals: CSS 12 and 13 px with a pixel of letter spacing

outputs.name: ozv_condbw44
outputs.for: the OPENZONE wordmark: CSS 20 px with 3 px of letter spacing

outputs.name: ozv_field13
outputs.for: edit boxes, CSS 12 px on a 1080-high screen

outputs.name: ozv_fieldb17
outputs.for: edit boxes in semibold, CSS 15 px

outputs.name: ozv_mono28
outputs.for: monospace lines (problems, file names), CSS 12 and 13 px

outputs.name: ozv_monofield14
outputs.for: the config editor's edit box, CSS 13 px
